gloss: anyway, in any case, either way

definitions.gloss: anyway, in any case, either way
definitions.explanation: Indicates that the outcome or conclusion remains the same regardless of circumstances or choices.

examples.japanese: どのみち⟦{間|ま}に{合|あ}わない→間に合う：01142_maniau⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{急|いそ}いでも→急ぐ：01191_isogu⟧⟦{無駄|むだ}→無駄：02512_muda⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: We won't make it anyway, so there's no point in hurrying.

examples.japanese: どのみち⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Either way, the result will be the same.

examples.japanese: どのみち⟦{言|い}わなきゃいけない→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦だから→だ：09496_da⟧、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Since I have to say it anyway, I'll say it now.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦しても→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦しても→する：00392_suru⟧、どのみち⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Whether you succeed or fail, either way it becomes experience.

notes:
NUANCE: Expresses inevitability — the outcome is fixed whichever path is taken.

ETYMOLOGY: どの (which) + ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧ (path) = "whichever path", the idea being that all roads lead to the same place.

COMMON CONTEXTS:
・Resignation: accepting an outcome that cannot be changed
・Pragmatic reasoning: since X is certain anyway, let's do Y
・Consolation: pointing out that the result is the same either way

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・⟦いずれにせよ→いずれにせよ：06779_izureniseyo⟧ / ⟦いずれにしても→いずれにしても：noentry⟧ — "in any case" (slightly more formal)
・⟦どうせ→どうせ：06355_douse⟧ — "anyway" (more pessimistic or dismissive)
・⟦{結局|けっきょく}→結局：03815_kekkyoku⟧ — "in the end" (a conclusion actually reached)
・⟦どっちみち→どっちみち：noentry⟧ — variant form, same meaning, slightly more casual

VS. ⟦どうせ→どうせ：06355_douse⟧:
・どのみち states inevitability neutrally
・⟦どうせ→どうせ：06355_douse⟧ usually carries a negative colouring — "it's pointless anyway", often with a note of self-deprecation

REGISTER: Neutral. Appropriate in both casual and semi-formal contexts.
